title: 3 yoshda ko'zini jarohatlagan bola 15 yoshda nima yaratdi?

scenes.text: 1812 yilda 3 yoshli fransuz bola Lui Brayl otasining ustaxonasida ko'zini jarohatladi.
Infeksiya ikkinchi ko'ziga ham o'tdi. 5 yoshida u butunlay ko'r bo'lib qoldi.
1824 yilga kelib, 15 yoshida, u bo'rtma nuqtalardan iborat yozuv tizimini yaratdi.
Har bir harf oltita nuqta o'rnidan tuziladi. Tizim 1829 yilda kitob bo'lib chiqdi.
Bugun ko'zi ojiz odamlar butun dunyoda shu yozuv bilan o'qiydi. U Brayl alifbosi deb ataladi.

description:
Lui Brayl 1812 yilda 3 yoshida ko'zini jarohatlagan va 5 yoshida butunlay ko'r bo'lgan. 1824 yilga kelib, 15 yoshida, oltita nuqtaga asoslangan yozuv tizimini yaratgan, u 1829 yilda nashr etilgan.

Siz 15 yoshingizda nimani orzu qilgansiz? Izohda yozing.
source: Fact-checked 2026-11-22 (via web search summaries; direct page fetch was blocked). Britannica: Louis Braille, https://www.britannica.com/biography/Louis-Braille (accident with a tool in his father's harness shop; treatise on the dot system 1829); Wikipedia: Louis Braille, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Louis_Braille (born 4 Jan 1809; system largely completed by 1824 at age 15, hence 'yilga kelib'); Biography.com, https://www.biography.com/inventor/louis-braille (both eyes infected, completely blind by age 5); History.com, https://www.history.com/articles/louis-braille-reading-writing-system-blind (presented the raised-dot system at the Royal Institute in autumn 1824, at 15); PMC article, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3036681 (first Braille book 1829); Wikipedia: Braille (six-dot cell).
